label: Retro
about: Phosphor (dark) and printed-manual (light) pixel art, drawn small and scaled up by whole pixels; square and stepped.

wallpapers.name: Horizon
wallpapers.description: A banded sun over a stepped ridge and a grid floor running to the horizon.

wallpapers.name: Peaks
wallpapers.description: Stepped mountain ranges with lit ridges under a pixel moon or a pale sun.

wallpapers.name: Circuit
wallpapers.description: Board traces running in from the edges to pads, vias and chips.

wallpapers.name: Dither
wallpapers.description: A ringed planet and a small moon in ordered dithering, like a riso print.

wallpapers.name: Stars
wallpapers.description: A pixel starfield with a shooting star, or a printed star chart in the light print.
